title: Globant announces Converge 2026: an edition about reinvention in the AI-Native Era, with Glob.AI at the center
summary: Globant (NYSE: GLOB), a global company focused on driving enterprise reinvention through AI, today announced Globant Converge 2026, its flagship virtual event, which will take place on December 10. Under the theme "Reinventing Companies for the AI-Native Era," Converge will bring together business and technology leaders from around the world who are transforming their companies and rethinking the way they build, deliver, and operate as AI becomes a foundational part of the enterprise.
